curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When an intrepid reporter traces an illicit pipeline back to the federal government, the blowback threatens to destroy his life.
curatedMovie.description: Based on a true story, journalist Gary Webb uncovers ties between the CIA, Nicaraguan Contra rebels, and crack cocaine entering California, triggering a ferocious smear campaign against him.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A somber, suspenseful true-crime political drama requiring engaged focus for an emotionally heavy solo watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Michael Cuesta crafts a tense, thoughtful procedural exploring the punishing personal costs of investigative reporting and institutional retaliation.
